During a storm, 25 mm of rain fell onto James' roof and drained off into a storage tank. James measured the amount of water to be 4500 litres.

What is the area of James' roof?

The basal metabolic rate (BMR) of a person refers to the minimum amount of energy (in kilojoules) needed to sustain basic bodily functions (that is, to keep the person alive) for a 24-hour period.

The Harris-Benedict Model can be used to estimate BMR, in kJ/day. It is given by:

$$\text{BMR}_{\text{female}} = 2783 + 40.0W + 7.7H - 19.6A$$

where $W$ is weight (in kg), $H$ is height (in cm) and $A$ is age (in years)

A 20-year old woman weighs 60 kg and she has a height of 157 cm. Use the Harris-Benedict Model to estimate the woman's BMR.

Give your answer to the nearest kJ/day

Marcus makes an initial deposit of \$10 000 on an investment at a rate of 5.5% per annum. compounding annually, and a additional deposit of \$500 at the end of each year.

Calculate the number of years it will take for Marcus' investment to accumulate to \$13 326.43? (Show working)

Note: You can use the following recurrence relation:

$$V_{n+1} = V_n(1+r) + D$$

where $V_{n+1}$ = the value of the investment after $(n+1)$ payments

$V_n$ = the value of the investment after $n$ payments

$r$ = the rate of interest

$D$ = the payment per compounding period

solutions.question: 6(c)
solutions.latex:
$AB^2 = 45^2 + 45^2 - 2\times 45\times 45\times\cos 100^\circ = 4753.275\ldots$

$AB = 68.943\ldots = 68.9\text{ m}$

Sector: $A = \dfrac{\theta}{360}\pi R^2 = \dfrac{260}{360}\times\pi\times 45^2 = 4594.579$

Rectangle: $A = LB = 68.9\times 30 = 2067$

Triangle: $A = \tfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C = \tfrac{1}{2}\times 45\times 45\times\sin 100^\circ = 997.117$

$\text{Total area} = 4594.579 + 2067 + 997.117 = 7658.7 = 7659\text{ m}^2\text{ (nearest m}^2\text{)}$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: length AB; 1: sector area; 1: rectangle area; 1: triangle area and total

notes: Paper groups unrelated items under Q1-Q6, so each is stored as its own question 1(a), 1(b) ... 6(c) (27 questions, 60 marks); parts sharing a stem or data (1(e), 2(c), 2(d), 3(e), 4(c), 5(c), 6(a)) stay together with the outer label removed (a, b, c...) and the printed label in src_label. There are no Section I/II headings; section is given as II for all. Cover says 'Assessment Task 1' although the file and task are AT3; task_code AT3 from the prompt. Printed typos kept: 'Trintyton' / 'Trinityton' (3(b)); 'an home loan' (5(a)); 'per annum. compounding annually, and a additional deposit' (5(d)); 4(b) 'two variables' with no full stop before 'Which he plots'; page 6 footer says 'Question 2 continued on page 6'. Guidelines error: in 6(b) the handwritten solution gives 8000 x 6.468 = $57744, but the product is 51 744 (the next line uses 51744 and the final answer 61 813.76 is correct); solution written with 51 744. In 4(c)(v)(beta) the guideline's handwriting reads 88.9 + 0.480x (checked: slope 0.480, intercept 88.92). Q3(b) figure crop cuts off the printed 'NOT TO SCALE' label to avoid the mark column. Guidelines mark_breakdowns are inferred from tick positions (no printed criteria). Drawn answers (2(c)b, 2(d)d, 2(e), 4(c)a/d, 6(a)b) are cropped solution figures. Extra writing pages 21-22 skipped; cover totals: Q1-Q6 each 10 marks, total 60.
